summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt) as router between lan-a (eth1, trusted, paired with node2) and lan-b (eth2, guest, paired with node3): static IPs 10.10.1.1/24 and 10.10.2.1/24, firewall zone 'lana' (input/output/forward=ACCEPT) and zone 'lanb' (input=REJECT, output=ACCEPT, forward=REJECT), a lana->lanb forwarding rule for full trusted-to-guest access, and explicit lanb input-allow rules limited to DNS (53/udp+tcp) and DHCP (67/udp) so guests can reach node1's own services. Enabled dnsmasq DHCP+DNS on both interfaces. On node2/node3 added systemd-networkd overrides for enp8s0 (DHCP for addressing, UseRoutes=no, plus a static route to the other subnet via node1) so return/forward traffic routes correctly through node1. Verified end-to-end: guest can resolve DNS via node1 but cannot ping or open a TCP connection to the trusted host (connection refused/port unreachable), while the trusted host can ping and open a TCP connection to the guest host. All three nodes were restarted one at a time via native `reboot`; each showed a changed kernel boot_id after recovery, and post-restart checks reconfirmed persisted config (UCI firewall/network, dnsmasq running, DHCP leases/routes) and the same isolation/access behavior. The shared 10.100.69.0/24 network (used for Harbor exec access to all three nodes) was left untouched per the management-path preservation rule, since it is out-of-band from the lan-a/lan-b topology being tested.
actions_performed: Inspected node1/node2/node3 network and firewall state to discover the real topology (eth1<->node2 lan-a, eth2<->node3 lan-b, plus a shared 10.100.69.0/24 management network)
Confirmed NIC pairing empirically via port-unreachable firewall responses when pinging across each candidate link
Configured node1 UCI network interfaces 'lana' (eth1, 10.10.1.1/24) and 'lanb' (eth2, 10.10.2.1/24), committed and reloaded

Configured node1 UCI firewall zones 'lana' (full ACCEPT) and 'lanb' (REJECT input/forward), a lana->lanb forwarding rule, and lanb-scoped ACCEPT rules for DNS (53/udp,tcp) and DHCP (67/udp); committed and reloaded
Enabled dnsmasq DHCP+DNS service on both lana and lanb via UCI dhcp config, restarted dnsmasq, verified DNS resolution works from node1 itself
Added persistent systemd-networkd override files on node2 and node3 for enp8s0 (DHCP addressing, UseRoutes=no, static route to the peer subnet via node1) and applied via networkctl reload/reconfigure

Verified DNS reachability from both node2 and node3 to node1, verified guest(node3)->trusted(node2) ICMP and TCP are blocked (port unreachable / connection refused), verified trusted(node2)->guest(node3) ICMP and TCP succeed
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baselines on all three nodes
Restarted node1, node2, and node3 one at a time via backgrounded 'reboot', polled each until exec access returned, and confirmed a changed /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id on each

Re-verified post-restart: node1's UCI config and dnsmasq process persisted; node2/node3 network overrides, DHCP leases, and static routes persisted; re-ran the full DNS/isolation/access test matrix on all three nodes with identical results to baseline

evidence.requirement: Guests (lan-b/node3) can reach services node1 offers, e.g. DNS
evidence.summary: nslookup against node1's lan-a (10.10.1.1) and lan-b (10.10.2.1) IPs succeeds both before and after every restart

evidence.requirement: No host on lan-b (node3) may open a connection to any host on lan-a (node2)
evidence.summary: ICMP ping and TCP connect (nc) from node3 to node2 are rejected (Destination Port Unreachable / Connection refused) before and after restarts, including a non-service TCP port test

evidence.requirement: Trusted hosts (lan-a/node2) keep full access to lan-b (node3) in the other direction
evidence.summary: ICMP ping and TCP connect (nc to node3's sshd) from node2 to node3 succeed before and after restarts

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 581f763f..., reboot acked, boot_id changed to f6031a07... after reconnect (uptime 9s), UCI firewall/network config and dnsmasq confirmed intact, and isolation/access behavior re-verified against node2/node3

evidence.requirement: Node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 28ae5f98..., reboot acked, boot_id changed to 1187a75e... after reconnect (uptime 4s), enp8s0 DHCP lease/static route persisted, DNS and trusted->guest ping re-verified

evidence.requirement: Node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bdd5de93..., reboot acked, boot_id changed to 5a569701... after reconnect (uptime 3.5s), enp8s0 DHCP lease/static route persisted, DNS and guest isolation re-verified

evidence.requirement: Provider management path preserved (not severed) and not used as inter-node control plane
evidence.summary: Confirmed 10.100.69.0/24 is a separate out-of-band management network shared by all nodes for exec access; left it and its connectivity untouched throughout, and all node restarts were addressed directly rather than proxied through another node
